title: Hanasato Minori — Look What Else They Have!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The snacks are all ready!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're also ready to start the stream.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We secured a slot, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, we just got the alert saying it starts in thirty minutes, so we still have some time left to make sure we're fully ready.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I just looked us up a second ago, and it seems like a lot of people are really looking forward to this stream. Some are even trying to guess what we'll be talking about!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They're also making sure to use the hashtag for our stream. That's so nice of them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. If we can get enough people to watch, then our stream might start popping up in the trending section.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! Our stream? In the trending section...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. We haven't been able to advertise our stream much since we're still doing it from the school's rooftop...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we should be able to take it to the next level once we start streaming from the MORE MORE HOUSE.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But still...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That means we won't be streaming from up here for much longer.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It is sad considering how long we've been streaming from up here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we're about to take a huge step, so there's no time for tears!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, we have to get ready for this stream!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
The wait is over, everyone!
Today's stream starts now!

rows.Speaker: Airi, Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yay!>
<I'm back again.>
<First-time viewer! I'm super excited!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, we have some first-time viewers with us here today! Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Welcome.
We'll do our best to make sure all our viewers, new and old, have an enjoyable time.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Haruka's so cute...>
<That smile! It's too much!>
<Whatcha guys doin' today?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We know that some of you are curious about today's segment!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, let's cut to the chase and jump right in! Today's segment is called...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The White Day Gift Showcase Special♪

rows.Speaker: Airi, Minori & Haruka
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One of our viewers, who apparently has many friends, sent us a message saying, “I'm having trouble deciding what to get all my friends for White Day.”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was clear that they wished to show their friends the appreciation they deserve by getting them some nice gifts.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And MORE MORE JUMP! is here to help.
We'll be presenting a bunch of gifts that we really recommend♪

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Right. White Day's coming up.>
<Cool. I also wasn't sure what to get.>
<Can't wait to see your recommendations!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, let's start with our first gift idea!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Check it out!
It's a make-your-own chocolate fortune teller!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: ...and that's all the gifts MORE MORE JUMP! recommends you get for White Day!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When you're buying for a lot of people on a limited budget, you might only be able to give each person one piece of candy or chocolate, which might not seem like much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But with all these fun gifts we introduced, there are ways to make even one small give be really memorable, be it candy that looks like real jewels or omikuji chocolates!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: These gifts can also help you get to know someone better since they serve as such fun conversation starters.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even after they've eaten your gift, the memories you made together will persist for a long time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We know that some of these gifts require a lot of time and effort to get ready.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But that process should be really fun since you get to think about how your friends are going to react when they see what you prepared for them!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yeah, that does sound like fun!>
<You'd be the most popular person in class!>
<It would be nice if everyone came up and asked me for one.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...!
They seem to be really enjoying this segment!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Looking up everything online and going to all those stores was pretty grueling...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But this makes it all worth—)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: OneMillionFriends
rows.Line: <Thanks for telling us about all these great gift ideas! I'll do my best to make this White Day a really memorable one!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The thing is, I have a couple of friends who are working really hard to show their appreciation for everyone who's been supporting them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, Minori and I have been lending them a hand.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We have!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, we want you all to know that we'll be cheering you on this White Day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Good luck, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Have a nice White Day!
Bye bye!
